title: Reading a post on the phone
question: You said a post should feel like a noticeboard item with Apple News's clean presentation, nothing added at the end, and no masthead of who it's from. What's missing, from my look at it on a phone: a short notice is two-thirds empty white with nothing marking where it ends; picture posts and picture-less posts look like two different apps; the title and date are timid ("Saturday 14 November" for something posted today); and the opening paragraph, which carries a notice, looks like every other one. Each option shows a picture post with an event card (left) and a short notice with no picture (right). Every option also gets: "Today" and "Yesterday" in the date, the first paragraph set a little larger, and a fix for pictures showing twice when a post leads with several.

options.label: The bulletin item
options.thesis: Set like an item in the printed bulletin: a navy rule, a date block (Today, 14 Nov) beside a big title, then the picture and text; the notice ends on a sand foot saying when and who posted it.
materials: sand foot where the notice ends
options.viewport: ‹ News; a navy rule; the date block TODAY 14 NOV beside the title and Church office; the picture with its caption; the larger first paragraph. The short notice ends on a sand foot: Posted today by the church office for everyone.
options.risk: The date block repeats what the meta line says, and a long title beside it wraps into three or four lines.

options.label: The post rises over its picture
options.thesis: Every post has a cover: its picture full-bleed behind a clear top bar, or with no picture the navy with the church's mark; the post is a white sheet that rises over it and scrolls up across it, sitting on sand when it's short.
materials: full-bleed cover under a clear top bar
sand ground under a short post
options.viewport: The carols picture across the top with ‹ News and ⋯ as round chips over it and its caption on a pill; the sheet rises over it: Church news, Church office · Today, the title, the first paragraph. A short notice is a white sheet on sand under the navy cover.
options.risk: The biggest change to the page, and a picture-led post shows its picture before its title.

options.label: The notice as a poster
options.thesis: The top of every post is a navy poster with the title set large and who and when under it, under the picture when there is one; a short notice's first paragraph goes on the poster too, so the notice is read at a glance.
materials: navy poster block with the church's mark
first paragraph on the poster when there's no picture
options.viewport: The carols picture across the column, then the navy poster: Carols by Candlelight: help us set up, Church office · Today, then the caption and text on white. The short notice is a navy poster holding the title, its first paragraph and Church office · Today.
options.risk: Closest to today's navy band, so it may feel like more of the same, only bigger.
